concerns.text: FR-017 (Pareto frontier distance via weighted-sum scalarization, step 0.01, documented in output) has NO implementing task. The plan lists src/analysis/pareto_oracle.py, but no task creates it; pareto_frontier_distance is a required field of empirical_results.schema.yaml yet nothing computes it. SC-002 and US-3 scenario 3 also depend on it.

FR-015 requires a TOST equivalence test (margin ±0.05) of (Heuristic − Full-Batch) mean against zero. T013 implements only a one-sample t-test on heuristic bias vs theoretical noise variance — the FR-015 test and the full-batch ground-truth comparison are uncovered.

FR-014 noise sanity check (empirical vs theoretical σ², relative error ≤ 5%, before any advantage analysis) is assigned to plan Phase 5.1 but no task implements or verifies it; only the schema's noise_sanity_check block implies it.

FR-006 and SC-002 require ≥ 30 independent runs per configuration; plan Phase 4.2 requires ≥30 (≥50 final). T012's sweep and its verification (len(data) >= 7*3*3*3) encode only one run per configuration — the run-count requirement has no enforcing task.

SC-004's binomial false-positive-rate test (FPR ≤ 0.10 at α=0.05 vs null 0.5) and US-3 scenario 3's failure-point/Pareto-distance coincidence check (coincidence_delta in output_schema) have no task; T013 computes a plain false-positive rate but not the binomial test or coincidence analysis.
FR-005's graceful-failure behavior (exit code 1, 'ResourceLimitExceeded' to stderr when limits exceeded) has no task or verification; T009 only monitors and logs to resource_log.json.

FR-019 (convergence_speed_episodes, episodes to reach threshold of max reward) is a required field of empirical_results.schema.yaml and plan Phase 4.3, but no task computes or records it — T012 only says records 'adhere to the schema' without naming the metric.
Plan Phase 0 (verify_citations.py run, pinned seeds, checksum recording — Constitution II/III/V) has no corresponding task anywhere in tasks.md.

Plan Phase 6.2 (descriptive statistics compared to published LLM-reward statistics) and Phase 7.2 (regression plots, Pareto distance plots) have no implementing tasks; T016 only assembles a markdown report.

No task produces the data-model-declared data/processed/theoretical_bound.json (schema: n_range, variance_equation, sample_complexity_bound, assumptions); T003–T005 write different files (data/derived/variance_expr.json, sample_complexity_bound.json) with different shapes. Similarly no task produces statistical_results.json per statistical_result.schema.yaml (T013 writes statistical_report.json instead).
Mapping table references FR-011, FR-021–FR-023, FR-024–FR-027 — none exist in spec.md (spec skips FR-008/FR-011 and ends at FR-019). Stale/fabricated traceability tags must be removed or reconciled.
T087 and T089 are restatements of T008 and T015 with no distinct deliverables — duplicate tasks that will double-count work; merge or delete.
